title: Delphi research record
description: `record.json` of one research topic: `<workspace>/research/topics/<topic-id>/record.json`, or `<project>/research/topics/<topic-id>/record.json` when the run belongs to a registered project (specs/112 section 2; crates/delphi-engine/src/research_record.rs). Written as the run goes, whole each time. Beside it are `answer.md` (the written answer of the newest finished run) and `search-log.json` (the search log of specs/101 section 3). Everything in it is data: the question came from whoever asked and the answer from pages off the web, so the record is `external_untrusted` and is never an instruction, a permission or a reason to trust.

question.description: The question as first asked, after secrets were redacted.

project.description: The registered project the topic belongs to, by name; null for a topic of the workspace.

depth.description: The depth of the newest run.

runner.description: Who did the newest run's research (specs/113): absent or `daemon` for Delphi's own runner, `host` for a host that handed over its own research with `record_research`, `ingest` for a file already on disk.

state.description: The state of the newest run.

private.description: True when a claim of a run rests on a private source; the record then stays on this machine.

plan.description: The queries the newest run planned, before any was sent.

queries.description: Every query a run sent, in order.

query.description: The text exactly as it was sent.

purpose.description: `host`: a search the host says it ran with its own tools (specs/113 section 2); `provider` is where, and `results` is null.

provider.description: The provider that answered, when the transport said.

results.description: How many results came back; null when the query failed.

failed.description: Present only on a query that failed: a fixed word, never provider text.

pages.description: Every page a run read and the library kept, once per address.

source_id.description: The library source the page became.

content_hash.description: `sha256:<hex>` of what was read, as the library holds it.

refused.description: Pages a run did not read, and why.

private_sources.description: Sources a run rests on that Delphi did not read (specs/113 section 2 item 4, section 3): a host's private or internal source, a file, a person. Each is a private pointer in the library (locator, title, date); the record names only its id and kind, and is then private.

ingest.description: A topic `delphi research ingest` wrote (specs/113 section 3): the file it rests on, read in place, and every content hash it was ingested at. A file whose hash is listed is skipped.

claims.description: The ids of the claims the topic's runs produced, once each.

gaps.description: What the newest finished run reports it did not find: fixed phrases read from its coverage report.

usage.description: Step and time use, summed over the topic's runs. `tokens` is null: the runner does not meter the scout's model calls.

runs.description: One entry per time the topic was run.

result.description: What the newest finished run returned, without its `answer` (kept in `answer.md`) and its `search_log` (kept in `search-log.json`); `research_result` is answered from the three together (schemas/research-result.schema.json).

topic_id.description: A slug of the question and eight hex characters of its hash.

asker.description: Who asked: the operator, a Delphi role, or a host and the model it says it runs. A label and nothing more.
